# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are building infrastructure for displaced and vulnerable populations. We hold ourselves
to a standard of conduct that reflects that responsibility: respectful, harassment-free
collaboration regardless of background, identity, nationality, or experience level.

## Expected behavior

- Assume good faith; disagree on ideas, not people.
- Give and receive technical criticism constructively — this project runs its governance
  through PR review, so direct, specific, respectful feedback is the norm.
- Respect that contributors work across time zones, languages, and connectivity constraints.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discriminatory language, or personal attacks in any project space (issues,
  PRs, discussions).
- Sharing any real beneficiary/patient data, PII, or identifying information about displaced
  individuals in any public project space — this violates both this code of conduct and the
  project's core "Identity Without Surveillance" principle.

## Enforcement

Report violations via the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) contact channel or by
emailing the addresses listed there. Maintainers will review and respond within a
reasonable timeframe given this is a solo-maintainer project.

Adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
